result:
The style guide is written and starts with READY, and the look-book page exists. No game code changed and nothing shipped. I haven't opened `index.html` in a browser.

- **Shots:** all 78 screens shot at 1080 and the six 4k ones (01, 45, 50, 52, 25, 18), in `notes/shots/all` and `notes/shots/all4k`. All 78 files exist. The look-book still says screen 24 did not stage; I did not check that file, so the line may be wrong.
- **Scores:** I ran the critic on the screens that stand for each shared shell, not all 78. Every one scored 2 except the mainframe racks screen (14), which scored 1, for profane placeholder text on a button row. The unscored screens share a shell with a scored one, so they show as "n/a" on the page. The scores are in `notes/ui/accept.json`.
- **Shared problems:**
  - Tiny type.
  - Explaining sentences on screen.
  - A different panel and close button on each screen.
  - No visible pad focus.
  - A cream detail card that is the brightest thing on its screen.
  - A raid HUD that shows a permanent controls list and a clipped minimap label.
- **Style guide:** `notes/ui/style-guide.md`.
  - The game already defines most of its colour and type tokens (CSS `:root` near line 40, and `UIC`, `HUDC` and `TYPE` in the script). The screens mostly ignore them, so the guide says which existing token to use and which variants to drop.
  - The guide sets one palette, five type sizes (56, 32, 20, 16 and 14) and an 8px spacing grid.
  - It defines one panel, button, tab, row, tile, toast and end-card shell. Close sits top-right and titles top-left, in sentence case.
  - It covers hover and pad focus, motion and sound.
  - It maps every old size, panel, button and colour to its replacement, and ends with an order of work.
- **Index page:** `notes/ui/index.html` shows all 78 pictures in five groups, worst first. Each has its score and one plain sentence, and clicking opens full size. It ends with an empty "Changes" section. The picture paths are relative (`../shots/all/…`).

One thing I decided myself: I kept the cream paper card only for the one-question ask dialog, and made the shop, craft, hire and contracts detail panes dark. I found no ruling from you about it in the memory folder.

I also didn't log anything in `changes.md`, since nothing visible changed.

TASK DONE
